faqs.question: What does Seska Investments Ltd do?
faqs.answer: Seska Investments Ltd provides printing, design and branding on Nasser Road in Kampala, Uganda. Its services include digital and offset printing, signage, ID cards, corporate apparel, branded merchandise, stickers, print finishing, technical plotting, website design and motion graphics.
faqs.label: Explore the service guide

faqs.question: Where is Seska Investments Ltd located?
faqs.answer: Seska Investments Ltd is based on Nasser Road in Kampala, Uganda. The website currently provides an area map; the exact workshop pin is not yet confirmed. Check the contact information before planning your visit.
faqs.label: View business details

faqs.question: What are Seska’s opening hours?
faqs.answer: Seska Investments Ltd lists its opening hours as Monday to Saturday, 8:00 am to 6:00 pm. Holiday hours are not listed; confirm availability before a special trip.
faqs.label: View business details

faqs.question: How much does printing at Seska cost?
faqs.answer: Seska quotes each job according to product, quantity, size, material and finishing. Delivery may add a separate charge. Share your specifications to request a quote in Ugandan shillings (UGX); the website does not publish a fixed price list.
faqs.label: Prepare your quote details

faqs.question: How long will my printing order take?
faqs.answer: Seska confirms turnaround for each order based on the product, quantity, materials and finishing. Include your required deadline in the brief so production and delivery timing can be agreed before the order proceeds.
faqs.label: Understand order approval

faqs.question: Is there a minimum order quantity at Seska?
faqs.answer: Minimum quantities at Seska vary by product and production method. State the quantity you need when preparing your brief. Seska can then advise on a suitable option; there is no single published minimum for all services.
faqs.label: Compare service requirements

faqs.question: Can Seska help with artwork and design?
faqs.answer: Seska offers design support as well as working with supplied artwork. Explain your project, intended audience and required output. The scope of design work and any design charges are agreed with the quote.
faqs.label: Prepare your artwork

faqs.question: Which artwork file formats does Seska accept?
faqs.answer: Seska lists PDF, PSD, JPG, PNG, Word, PowerPoint, AI and EPS as artwork formats. Include the intended finished size. A print-ready PDF is a useful starting point, but suitability must be reviewed for the chosen production process.
faqs.label: Read the artwork guidance

faqs.question: Does Seska deliver outside Kampala?
faqs.answer: Delivery from Seska can be arranged across Uganda. Include your destination in the brief so delivery availability, timing and charges can be agreed with your quote. Collection in Kampala is also available.
faqs.label: Plan collection or delivery

faqs.question: Does Seska offer pricing for bulk printing orders?
faqs.answer: Seska prices printing according to quantity, material, format and finishing. Request a quote for your required quantity, or ask to compare several quantities. A bulk discount is not automatically guaranteed.
faqs.label: Build a quote brief

faqs.question: Will my printed colours match my screen?
faqs.answer: Screens and printed materials can display colours differently. For a Seska print order, share brand colour references and discuss a proof or sample if close colour matching is important. Agree the colour expectations before approving production.
faqs.label: Review before production

faqs.question: How do payment and artwork approval work at Seska?
faqs.answer: Seska agrees artwork, specifications, the quote and payment arrangements before production. The website lists Mobile Money, bank transfer and cash; company terms may be available for approved accounts. Confirm payment instructions directly with Seska before paying.
faqs.label: Read the ordering steps

faqs.question: Does the website send my project brief to Seska?
faqs.answer: The Seska website prepares a project brief on your device. It does not automatically send the brief or upload artwork. Use Copy or Download to save the brief, then share it through a confirmed Seska contact channel.
faqs.label: Prepare a project brief

faqs.question: How can I contact Seska about privacy or deletion requests?
faqs.answer: Email info@seskainvestments.com for privacy questions and access, correction or deletion requests. The project brief tool does not automatically send your form entries to Seska. The privacy notice explains optional analytics and your choices.
faqs.label: Read the privacy notice

steps.title: Prepare the project details
steps.text: List the product or service, finished size, quantity, preferred materials and finishing, deadline and collection or delivery location. These details help Seska prepare a quote in UGX.

steps.title: Prepare artwork or describe the design
steps.text: Provide ready artwork or explain the design support you need. Seska lists PDF, PSD, JPG, PNG, Word, PowerPoint, AI and EPS. Include the finished size; file suitability is reviewed for the chosen process. The website does not upload these files.

steps.title: Save and share your brief
steps.text: Complete the project brief form, then copy or download the prepared text. It stays on your device until you choose to share it. Direct online enquiry delivery and artwork upload are not connected; use a confirmed Seska contact channel.

steps.title: Agree the quote, artwork and payment
steps.text: Confirm specifications, design scope, material, finishing, production timing and payment arrangements with Seska. Share brand colour references and discuss a proof or sample if colour accuracy matters. Production follows the agreed approval.

steps.title: Production and finishing
steps.text: The approved order moves into the agreed printing, branding or production process. Finishing may include trimming, binding or lamination, according to the job. Timing depends on the agreed product and specifications.

steps.title: Arrange collection or delivery
steps.text: Collect in Kampala or discuss delivery across Uganda. Agree the destination, availability, delivery charges and timing with your quote. Do not assume a delivery fee or date until it is confirmed.
